issues.reason: Compound concepts makes modifier-genus exposure determined, not optional, and fixes the criterion as part of speech plus the predication test ('the market is weekly' passes, unlike the relational *'the secretary is assistant'), so the missing (Inheritance weekly_market weekly) is a stated-rule violation -- the three listed adjective classes illustrate the criterion rather than exhausting it, and the same parse rightly exposes 'inland'.

defect_summary: The compliant form adds one atom beside the head genus -- (Inheritance weekly_market weekly) (STV 1.0 0.99) -- since 'weekly' is an adjective predicable of the market and the exposure decision is determined by the instruction set.
notes: The rest is sound: the bare-plural habitual takes the 0.9/0.9 Skolem-event rule with the origin restriction as a premise conjunct and no QuantifierPhrase companion, the coordinated origin PP splits into one rule per conjunct (the same result the Or-in-a-premise rule would give), and the shared definite market constant is asserted top-level as required.
